subject: ela
intro: Determine multiple themes and summarize objectively.

items.prompt:
A complex literary text often carries:
A) two or more interacting themes
B) no theme at all
C) only a title
items.answer: A) two or more interacting themes

solution.answer: A) two or more interacting themes

items.prompt:
An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key events without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key events without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key events without opinion

items.prompt:
Two themes in a text can:
A) interact and build on one another
B) never relate
C) only repeat the title
items.answer: A) interact and build on one another

solution.answer: A) interact and build on one another

items.prompt:
Read.

The explorer mapped new worlds but destroyed the peoples he found.

Two themes are:
A) discovery and destruction
B) only that maps are useful
C) only that travel is long

steps: Two interacting themes. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary?
A) The greedy explorer cruelly and tragically ruined innocent peoples.
B) The explorer mapped new worlds but destroyed the peoples he found there.
C) This is a devastating story.
items.answer: B) The explorer mapped new worlds but destroyed the peoples he found there.

solution.answer: B) The explorer mapped new worlds but destroyed the peoples he found there.

items.prompt:
When two themes INTERACT, they:
A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another
B) cancel each other out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another

solution.answer: A) reinforce, complicate, or deepen one another

items.prompt:
Read.

The scientist's cure saved a generation, but the fame it brought corrupted her and estranged her from those she loved.

Two interacting themes are BEST stated as:
A) The good of her work and the corrupting cost of its fame.
B) Science is hard.
C) Fame is nice.
items.answer: A) The good of her work and the corrupting cost of its fame.

steps: Two themes that interact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The good of her work and the corrupting cost of its fame.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) The soldier returned home after the war.
B) The poor, broken soldier came home to a cruel, uncaring world.
C) He struggled to find work.
items.answer: B) The poor, broken soldier came home to a cruel, uncaring world.

solution.answer: B) The poor, broken soldier came home to a cruel, uncaring world.
